verdict.rationale: WorkOS documents a first-party capability for users to connect their own third-party accounts to an application ('connect their third-party accounts', data providers where the authenticated user connects or disconnects their own accounts), which is the core of user-consented delegated access to third-party APIs. The evidence does not show how tokens for those accounts are issued, refreshed or kept short-lived, or used by an agent for tool calls. Vault is generic encrypted storage, an adjacent feature, and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented retrieval of short-lived, refreshed access tokens for connected accounts, agent/tool-call usage of delegated tokens, token-exchange semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
